# openssh — 2010 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 3 openssh CVEs of 2010 are in `data/cve/vendors/openssh/2010.jsonl`.

### CVE-2010-4478
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2010-12-06 | Updated: 2026-05-28 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: n/a; CWE-287 CWE-287 Improper Authentication
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

OpenSSH 5.6 and earlier, when J-PAKE is enabled, does not properly validate the public parameters in the J-PAKE protocol, which allows remote attackers to bypass the need for knowledge of the shared secret, and successfully authenticate, by sending crafted values in each round of the protocol, a related issue to CVE-2010-4252.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2010-5107
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2013-03-07 | Updated: 2026-05-29 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: n/a; CWE-400 CWE-400 Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

The default configuration of OpenSSH through 6.1 enforces a fixed time limit between establishing a TCP connection and completing a login, which makes it easier for remote attackers to cause a denial of service (connection-slot exhaustion) by periodically making many new TCP connections.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a
